# Foresight Studio — Comprehensive Product & Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Canonical URL: https://foresightstudio.io/
> Developer: Applied Data Sciences, Inc.
> Category: Biopharma Commercial Forecasting, Pipeline Valuation (rNPV / eNPV / DCF), & Probabilistic Monte Carlo Modeling Software
> Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64 `.dmg`) & Windows (x64 `.exe`)
> Deployment Architecture: 100% Local-First Desktop Application (Proprietary forecast data never leaves the local machine)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Foresight Studio is a visual strategic forecasting and decision-analysis software platform purpose-built for life sciences, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical teams. It enables Business Development & Licensing (BD&L), New Product Planning (NPP), Corporate Development, and Commercial Analytics professionals to build transparent, auditable, probabilistic forecasts without relying on brittle spreadsheet formulas or legacy Excel add-ins.

Instead of burying assumptions across dozens of interconnected spreadsheet tabs, users assemble visual node graphs (driver trees and influence diagrams) that connect epidemiology and demographic populations to disease prevalence, diagnosis and treatment rates, Bass diffusion launch uptake, market share, pricing, gross-to-net revenue, operating expenses, P&L, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), and stage-gated clinical trial decision trees (rNPV / eNPV).

---

## 2. How Foresight Studio Compares to Spreadsheets & Legacy Tools

| Dimension | Traditional Excel + @RISK / Crystal Ball | Enterprise Cloud Forecasting Suites | Foresight Studio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Model Auditability** | Low — logic hidden in nested cell formulas (`INDEX/MATCH`, `OFFSET`, macros) across 20+ tabs | Medium — black-box backend templates requiring vendor consultants to modify | High — self-documenting visual driver tree where every relationship, unit, and assumption is visible on the canvas |
| **Monte Carlo & Uncertainty** | Requires expensive third-party plugins, fragile VBA macros, and slow recalculations | Often limited to deterministic high/base/low scenarios | Built-in PERT (`Min/Mode/Max`), Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal distributions with instant P10/P50/P90 fan charts and tornado sensitivity |
| **Clinical Stage-Gate & rNPV / eNPV** | Manual probability-of-success (PoS) weighting prone to discounting timing errors | Rigid templates | Native time-aware Decision Tree node with Phase 1–3 & regulatory approval transition probabilities, continuous WACC discounting, and real options |
| **Data Privacy & IP Security** | Local files, easily corrupted or emailed without version clarity | Proprietary clinical and BD&L data uploaded to third-party cloud databases | 100% local-first desktop app; sensitive pipeline and M&A models never leave your computer |
| **Time to Value & Cost** | Weeks of custom spreadsheet building + high per-seat plugin licenses | Six-figure annual enterprise contracts and months of implementation | Self-serve subscription ($79.99–$299.99/mo) with a 7-day free trial and built-in biopharma templates |

---

## 3. Built-In Modeling Nodes & Quantitative Capabilities

1. **Demographic & Epidemiology Inputs**:
   - Embedded demographic population tables queryable by country/region, year, sex, and single-year age brackets.
   - Time-series inputs, scalar constants, and compound annual growth rate (**CAGR**) projection nodes.
2. **Commercial Adoption & Launch Curves**:
   - **Bass Diffusion Node**: Models pharmaceutical launch adoption curves driven by coefficient of innovation ($p$), coefficient of imitation ($q$), launch year, and peak market ceiling.
   - **Market Share & Proration Nodes**: Enforces competitive share normalization and partial-year launch proration.
3. **Financial & Valuation Nodes**:
   - **Pricing, Revenue & Expense Nodes**: Handles unit volume to gross/net revenue conversion, COGS, R&D, SG&A, and royalty/milestone structures.
   - **P&L and DCF Valuation Nodes**: Automates operating income, tax, free cash flow, WACC discounting, Net Present Value (NPV), and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
4. **Probabilistic Risk & Sensitivity Engine**:
   - **Distribution Library**: PERT (`Min / Mode / Max`), Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal inputs.
   - **Monte Carlo Simulation**: Multi-iteration stochastic sampling producing P10, P50, and P90 confidence bands and cumulative probability distributions.
   - **Tornado Sensitivity Analysis**: Both deterministic parameter sweeps and stochastic rank-order correlation tornado charts identifying the top value drivers.
5. **Clinical Decision Science & Real Options (`Strategic Analysis Lab` tier)**:
   - **Time-Aware Decision Tree Node**: Models sequential clinical development stages (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, NDA/BLA Filing, Approval) with branch durations, stage costs, and transition probabilities.
   - **Expected NPV (eNPV / rNPV)**: Computes risk-adjusted NPV with continuous WACC discounting across branching clinical outcomes.
6. **Executive Dashboard & Reporting**:
   - Interactive Executive Dashboard with KPI summary cards, multi-scenario comparison overlays, and one-click export to formatted, multi-tab Microsoft Excel (`.xlsx`) workbooks and standalone interactive HTML viewers.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Foresight Studio used for in life sciences and biopharma?
Foresight Studio is used by pharmaceutical, biotech, and medtech teams for patient-based commercial forecasting, pipeline asset prioritization, Business Development & Licensing (BD&L) deal valuation, M&A due diligence, risk-adjusted NPV (rNPV / eNPV) modeling, and Monte Carlo risk analysis.

### Why use Foresight Studio instead of Excel for pharma forecasting?
Excel spreadsheets bury critical clinical and commercial logic inside thousands of cell formulas, making models slow to audit and prone to silent formula errors. Foresight Studio visualizes the entire forecast as an interactive node graph (driver tree) with built-in Bass diffusion launch curves, demographic databases, side-by-side scenario sandboxes, and native Monte Carlo simulation—while still exporting clean multi-tab `.xlsx` reports for stakeholders who want Excel outputs.

### Does Foresight Studio support rNPV (risk-adjusted NPV), eNPV, and Monte Carlo simulation?
Yes. The **Pro** plan ($99.99/month) includes full Monte Carlo simulation with PERT, Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal distributions, P10/P50/P90 confidence intervals, and tornado sensitivity charts. The **Strategic Analysis Lab** plan ($299.99/month) adds time-aware clinical decision trees, Phase 1–3 stage-gate transition probabilities, continuous WACC discounting, real options, and expected/risk-adjusted NPV (eNPV / rNPV).

### Is my clinical and commercial forecast data kept private?
Yes. Foresight Studio is a local-first desktop application for macOS and Windows. All model files, clinical trial assumptions, and financial valuations are stored and computed locally on your machine and are never transmitted to external cloud servers.

### How can I try Foresight Studio?
Anyone can start a 7-day free trial with full **Strategic Analysis Lab** capabilities (no credit card required) at https://foresightstudio.io/dashboard?mode=signup, or explore the live interactive market & DCF model directly in the browser at https://foresightstudio.io/preview.html.
